title: SOS: enforce origin signature verification (silent drop)
description: Gap 1 of a6qg: POST /sos performs NO signature verification (spec/12-apps.md 18.4.1). verify_sos_origin() in python/src/lichen/coap/sos_origin.py has zero production callers. Wire verification into SosResource.render_post incl TOFU via TrustStore. Flip xfail(strict) test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped; update green doc test test_unsigned_sos_accepted_by_resource_today.
notes: SRC SIDE DONE (worker2, branch beads-worker-2): verify_sos_origin wired into SosResource.render_post per main's landed design. Body = core alert dict + envelope {pubkey: 32B bytes, sig: 56B wire (>Q seq + 48B Schnorr)}; origin_addr reconstructed as 0200:0000:0000:0000:<iid> from the 16-hex node/from field. Gate order: field validation (4.00) -> envelope present/parse (4.01) -> pubkey-to-IID derivation (4.01) -> verify_sos_origin over canonical CBOR of core dict (4.01) -> optional TrustStore.verify_or_pin TOFU via new SosResource(trust_store=...) param, TrustError -> 4.01. Unsigned/invalid = 4.01 Unauthorized (non-success, no state change; aiocoap CON requires a response so literal silent-drop is unrepresentable on this stack). Known gaps vs main's 92469a5d16, left out of scope: origin-sequence replay gate (OriginSequenceTracker) and signed DELETE cancel - if stage 2 ports main's tests, test_replayed_sequence_dropped / test_sequence_must_advance / signed-cancel DELETE tests will need that follow-up. Stage 2: remove xfail on test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped (now XPASSes), replace test_unsigned_sos_accepted_by_resource_today with signed-body variant using main's _signed_sos_body helper shape; other unsigned-POST tests (test_first_sos_accepted, test_third_before_cooldown_rejected_429, test_fourth_in_hour_rejected, test_vector_consumers_lci sos_type/ts tests, test_sos_resource put/observe tests) need signed bodies.
